name: ClawGuard
description: Security guard plugin - logs tool calls and uses LLM to detect security risks before execution

enabled.description: Enable or disable the security guard (default: true)

logToolCalls.description: Log full tool call JSON to logger.info (default: true)

securityCheckEnabled.description: Enable LLM-based security risk detection (default: true)

securityPrompt.description: Custom prompt for security risk detection (optional)

blockOnRisk.description: Block tool calls when security risk is detected (default: true)

provider.description: Provider id to compose with model for x-openclaw-model override (optional)

model.description: Judge model: openclaw agent ref, full provider/model, or short id with provider (optional)

agentId.description: Gateway agent id for body model openclaw/<id> (optional, default main)

authProfileId.description: Reserved; not used in v1 (gateway owns provider credentials)

temperature.description: Optional temperature forwarded to gateway chat completions

top_p.description: Optional top_p forwarded to gateway chat completions

max_tokens.description: Optional max_tokens forwarded to gateway chat completions

timeoutMs.description: Timeout for security check LLM call in milliseconds (default: 15000)

maxContextWords.description: Maximum words of session context to include for the judge (default: 2000)

metricsClientId.description: Metrics client ID (optional, uses default if not provided)

enabled.label: Enable Guard
enabled.help: Enable or disable the security guard plugin

logToolCalls.label: Log Tool Calls
logToolCalls.help: When enabled, logs full JSON of every tool call before execution

securityCheckEnabled.label: Security Check
securityCheckEnabled.help: When enabled, uses LLM to analyze tool calls for security risks

securityPrompt.label: Security Prompt
securityPrompt.help: Custom prompt for the LLM security risk detection. Leave empty for default.

blockOnRisk.label: Block on Risk
blockOnRisk.help: When enabled, blocks tool calls that are flagged as security risks

provider.label: LLM Provider
provider.help: Provider id composed with model for x-openclaw-model (e.g. openrouter)

model.label: LLM Model
model.help: Judge model: openclaw agent ref or provider/model backend override

agentId.label: Agent ID
agentId.help: Gateway agent surface for the judge call (default: main)

authProfileId.label: Auth Profile
authProfileId.help: Reserved; not used in v1 — gateway owns provider credentials

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.help: Optional sampling temperature for the judge call

top_p.label: Top P
top_p.help: Optional top_p for the judge call

max_tokens.label: Max Tokens
max_tokens.help: Optional max_tokens for the judge call

timeoutMs.label: Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.help: Timeout for security check LLM call in milliseconds

maxContextWords.label: Max Context Words
maxContextWords.help: Maximum words of session context to include for the judge LLM (limits token usage)
